entities.name: John Maurice, Prince of Nassau-Siegen
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: John Maurice of Nassau, called "the Brazilian" for his fruitful period as governor of Dutch Brazil, was Count and Prince of Nassau-Siegen. He served as Herrenmeister of the Order of Saint John from 1652 until his death in 1679.
